tasks.goal: Reorder desktop collapse/project controls and restore a standalone tab row across side, top and mixed layouts without mobile or tab-command regression.
input_facts: Side desktop currently renders project selection before the collapse control
Desktop UiTabs is currently a descendant of app-header__tabs
Top and mixed layouts own global controls in app-top-navigation
UiTabs and tabsStore own tab behavior and must remain unchanged
AppLayout.vue and styles.css contain unrelated edits that must be preserved
invariants: tabsStore remains the sole route-tab state owner
UiTabs behavior and currentPath contract remain unchanged
Project context, sidebar collapse and global account actions remain usable
Exactly one UiTabs is rendered at every viewport
No page-level horizontal overflow is introduced
interface_contracts: AppLayout passes route.fullPath to the single UiTabs instance
Collapse controls toggle theme.sidebarCollapsed only when side navigation exists
Project selectors continue to call projectContext.select
non_goals: Do not edit UiTabs, tabsStore, routes, business pages, backend or dependencies
Do not redesign mobile or global navigation behavior
action_bounds: Modify only shell template order, mount conditions and related CSS selectors
Suppress empty desktop secondary headers without changing state owners
Keep all corrections reversible within the two approved files
acceptance_checks: Side and mixed desktop collapse control is left of project selection wherever side navigation exists
Desktop UiTabs is a separate full-width row and no breadcrumb is visible
Switch, direct close, refresh, close others and close all retain their outcomes
Top and mixed desktop layouts have no empty secondary header or duplicate tabs
375x812, 390x844 and 430x932 retain readable title, sticky tabs, drawer project selector and no overflow
Frontend build, focused diff and fresh console checks pass
evidence_required: Build and diff command outputs and exit codes
Side/top/mixed desktop DOM order, parent relationship and rectangles
tasks.rollback: Restore the pre-task control order, UiTabs mount conditions and shell CSS while preserving unrelated changes in the same files.
stop_conditions: Completion requires edits outside the two approved product files
A supported layout mode requires a new product decision
Mobile regression cannot be corrected within approved shell selectors
escalation_conditions: Desktop breadcrumb or mobile design must change
A layout mode must be removed or project context relocated

checks: Verify required mobile viewports and console
